dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three primary 'O'-shaped structures in the mid-dorsal field feature sharp, high-intensity white perimeters with a distinct high-frequency transition from bright exterior to a low-luminance dark interior. A large 'C'-shaped structure in the posterior-lateral quadrant exhibits a more diffuse, irregular white boundary with a granular gradient transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized, solid white pixel clusters is concentrated in the anterior-dorsal region and along the lower lateral margin; these lack internal gradients and appear as asymmetrical, high-contrast points against the dark substrate.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A central scalene triangle is formed by the centroids of the three largest 'O' rings. A linear chain of four smaller high-intensity blobs is visible following the lateral midline towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique 'figure-eight' pattern is present in the center-left dorsal region, formed by the intersection of two high-contrast annuli sharing a common boundary segment.
